[/font][font=Arial]These are mostly, very similar cardboard boxes as non-functional decorative objects, made with intention to fill up those empty spaces and corners in the attic or cellar, shed or any other storage. Only one color, sixteen pieces overall.

Tested and used originally only for my game, but should work okay for anyone else, too. They appear in the furniture catalogue, not in shops.
